title: auditMetadata
body:
## auditMetadata

Audit the metadata of a media set against a closed rule set: required fields, conflicting or duplicated sources, malformed values, time plausibility (GPS UTC against the capture instant, digitization before capture), a privacy inventory of location, device and creator fields, and identical-content duplicates. Findings name the rule, item, field, state and evidence in audit.json and a typed findings.csv. It reports observations only: a clean audit is not certification, a finding is not proof of tampering, and nothing is changed or removed.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Findings are about recorded metadata, not about the photographed event.
- privacyInventory lists what a file carries so you can decide; it does not make a file safe to share.
- requiredFields needs require; timePlausibility needs a recorded offset to compare GPS and capture times.
- Every audited field is read by the same independent decoders and anchored to ExifTool as inspectMetadata.

Native binding: `the same fixed native listing, used to anchor the independent reader; the audit itself is host logic over typed records`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `profiles` | Which groups of catalogued fields to assess: capture, device, exposure, description, rights, location and rendering. Fields outside the selected profiles are unassessed, neither read nor claimed absent. inspectMetadata writes one typed CSV per profile. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":7,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["capture","device","exposure","description","rights","location","rendering"]}}` | omitted |
| `require` | Catalogue fields that every item must record. Each item for which one is not present gets a requiredFields finding naming the state (absent, unreadable, unsupported, ambiguous). Requires the requiredFields rule. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":40,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["capturedLocal","capturedSubSecond","capturedOffset","capturedUtc","digitizedLocal","modifiedLocal","cameraMake","cameraModel","software","lensMake","lensModel","bodySerialNumber","lensSerialNumber","exposureTime","fNumber","isoSpeed","focalLength","focalLength35mm","exposureBias","title","description","keywords","rating","creator","copyright","rightsUrl","gpsLatitude","gpsLongitude","gpsAltitude","gpsDirection","gpsDirectionReference","gpsDatum","gpsUtcDate","gpsUtcTime","gpsUtc","locationCity","locationCountry","orientation","imageWidth","imageHeight"]}}` | omitted |
| `rules` | Which audit rules to apply: requiredFields, sourceConflicts, unreadableValues, timePlausibility, privacyInventory and duplicateContent. Rules only report; none changes a file or certifies one. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":6,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["requiredFields","sourceConflicts","unreadableValues","timePlausibility","privacyInventory","duplicateContent"]}}` | omitted |
| `gpsToleranceSeconds` | The largest difference between the GPS UTC stamp and the capture instant that timePlausibility accepts without a finding. Meaningful only with that rule. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":86400}` | omitted |
| `creatorInterpretation` | How the EXIF Artist string is read into the creator list on the read operations: literal (default, the original behaviour: one string) or mwg (split on "; " outside quotes, the Metadata Working Group creator list, with an Artist that does not re-join exactly reported as unreadable). Omitting it or choosing literal keeps every existing plan and result unchanged; mwg is what editMetadata always uses to read back creators. | `{"type":"enum","values":["literal","mwg"]}` | omitted |
